compiled_by: Auditor B (Claude Fable) from six scout lanes (F1 solar and storage press, F2 wind and energy press, F3 official sources, F4 national news, F5 planning and regional, F6 grid and data centres)
how_to_read: "use": evidence that the feed or its headlines are live and relevant. "test": plausible but unproven; the first workflow run decides, and a feed that fails or is stale is dropped. "reject": dead, stale, off-topic or not a feed.

"auditor_check": "opened" means the auditor fetched the feed URL today and read its items; "not_opened" means the auditor could not (fetch restrictions in the auditor's environment), which says nothing about the feed.
"scout_fetched_directly" false means the scout relied on a mirror, a directory or the publisher's HTML page, not the feed itself.
Samples are titles, links and dates only.
Terms notes are the scouts' one-line readings and are not legal advice; items marked "not checked" remain unchecked.
